about: Ceilings for scripts/click-paths-journey.mjs: clicks, fields typed into, full document loads and ceremony loads (a page with a password field, or a ceremony route in test/destinations.json) per job, from Work (/) on the demo at 1440x900. A run over any number fails. A change that shortens a path lowers its numbers here in the same change (--write-ceilings rewrites them from a run); raising one needs a line in the pull request saying why.
